stories.title: New maternity safety scheme rolled out across Wales
stories.summary: A new scheme giving families a direct route to raise urgent concerns about a mother or baby’s deteriorating health is being rolled out in hospitals across Wales, but the minister responsible could not say when it would be running consistently everywhere. stories.title: Delays on M56 near Manchester Airport after multi-vehicle crash
stories.summary: Drivers heading to Manchester Airport are facing lengthy delays this morning after a multi-vehicle crash closed part of the M56. Traffic has been stopped on the M56 eastbound between junction seven for Bowdon and junction six for Hale, close to the airport. stories.summary: Cash collected from an unnamed nail bar in the Wrexham area formed part of a £1.6 million money laundering operation run by a people smuggling gang whose five members have been jailed for a total of almost 40 years. stories.title: Council tax and cuts alone will not close Flintshire’s £22m budget gap, cabinet hears
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council cannot currently rule out issuing a Section 114 notice, cabinet has been told, as it faces a budget gap of up to £22 million for 2027-28. stories.summary: North Wales Police had the second highest proportion of officers who made no arrests last year among forces examined by a national newspaper investigation.
